title: Taskflow Agent finds Signal iOS admin-delete authorization check after deletion
summary: The Admin Delete handler deleted a target message before validating that the requesting sender was an administrator, so a non-admin group member could delete another member’s messages despite a later validation failure.
ai_role: GHSL directly credits discovery to Taskflow Agent and verification by Jaroslav Lobačevski. Reported 2026-03-17, fixed in code 2026-03-18 and released in Signal iOS 8.3 on 2026-03-19; Signal declined to assign a CVE.
classification_note: The cited sources document the finding and remediation; they do not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed in Signal iOS 8.3, released to GitHub and the App Store on 2026-03-19. Attack window depends on server-configured admin-delete age, stated as about two days by default.

impacts.conditions: Signal iOS performs the admin-delete authorization check after deletion; unauthorized message deletion is the documented effect.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
